title: I Have Published 125 Research Papers. Now I Am Publishing My Research Here.
coverage: opening + one cue-ranked passage + headings; partial inspection

passages.text: I have published over 125 peer-reviewed papers. I have an h-index
The first study drops on Saturday. I gave Claude 10 poems and asked it to read them. Then I read its readings. Poetry turns out to be a precise diagnostic tool for what language models can and cannot
